title: test(app-shell): pin the four remaining /layers reads' 404 as "never published" (objectui#11799)
body:
Fixes #11799
Clause-②: no

## What this does

This takes the card's last remainder: the four `GET /meta/:type/:name/layers` reads that objectui#11892 and objectui#11928 kept. objectstack-ai/objectstack#22397 was answered (a), by design: the framework keeps answering 404 for a name with no stored layer, the author included. Triage's unlock on this card asks each read to skip `/layers` where the editor already knows the item is draft-only. Otherwise the read takes its 404 as "never published", with no error state, and errors are not suppressed in general.

I measured each read on `main` 6694abe75, over the real editor and a real `MetadataClient` on an in-memory server that answers as the framework does:

| Read | Skippable with what the editor holds? | What its 404 does today |
|---|---|---|
| Metadata edit page, first load (`MetadataResourceEditPage` load effect) | No. The draft read goes out beside it, and a pending draft does not say the item was never published. | Opens on the draft: no error strip, no lock banner, no reset/delete control. The Layers sheet shows overlay `none` and the no-baseline diff. |
| Embedded item editor, save read (`EmbeddedItemEditor` `doSave`) | No. It holds only the item snapshot and the parent's name. The parent page's answer could only reach it through `MetadataDetailDrawer` and `RelatedPanel`, which are outside this claim's surface. | Opening sends no read at all. On save the read raises nothing of its own (see Acceptance notes for what the save then PUTs). |
| Permission matrix, package-door save re-read (`doSave`) | No. The objectui#9420 guarantee (other packages' rows survive) holds only with a fresh read. The published set list was read at open and can be stale, and the first save after a load is unpinned. | The draft is saved over its own slice, with no refusal. |
| List-view panel, a view that exists nowhere (`useObjectListViewDraft` load) | No. There is no draft, and the object's `listViews` is not the stored-view answer (seat 1's measurement on objectui#11928). | The buffer row is null and there is no failure. The canvas shows the view the first edit will create. |

**No executable code changes.** `MetadataClient.layered()` already resolves a 404 as an envelope with every layer null and never rejects on it, so none of the four reads raises an error state for a draft-only item. A 5xx still throws and still shows its error. This PR pins that behaviour for each read, with the controls the dispatch asked for. No REST answer, export, prop, type member or pack key changes.

## Pins

All of them run over the real editor and a real `MetadataClient` on the in-memory server. Requests and their statuses are counted on that server.

- `ResourceEditPage.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx`, new describe, 4 tests:
  - a draft-only item opens with one `/layers` (404) and no error, lock banner or reset/delete control, and the Layers sheet shows overlay `none`;
  - CONTROLS: a published item's layers are used (the delete control, overlay `env`); a published item locked by its layers shows the lock banner from that answer; a 5xx shows "Failed to load …" even with a draft in hand.
- `EmbeddedItemEditor.layersRead-11799.test.tsx`, new file, 3 tests:
  - opening an item of a draft-only parent sends no request;
  - CONTROLS: a published parent's save reads its layers once and splices the item into that body; a 5xx is the save's error, and nothing is PUT.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx`, new describe, 3 tests, through the real client. The existing `packageDoorRereadRefusal` pins mock `layered`, so these are the first to cover the client's real 404 handling here.
  - A "+ New" set's autosave gets its re-read's 404 and saves over its own slice, with no refusal.
  - CONTROLS: a published set keeps the rows another package contributed; a 5xx still refuses.
- `ObjectListViewInspector.layersUnsaved-11799.test.tsx`, new describe, 2 tests:
  - a view that exists nowhere gets one `/layers` (404) and no failure, and the canvas shows the seeded view;
  - CONTROL: a 5xx is the load failure.
- The three existing files' headers no longer list these reads as not covered.

Changeset: `.changeset/11799-layers-draft-only.md`, with empty frontmatter (no release) because the change is tests only. The dispatch asked for a `patch`. With no executable change, a patch would release the fixed group for nothing. `check-changeset-presence` accepts the empty frontmatter as the declaration.

## Verification, on head d7613848b

- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the four pin files: `Test Files  4 passed (4)`, `Tests  22 passed (22)`.
- `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^... --concurrency=2` (`Tasks: 28 successful, 28 total`), then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists all four touched test files.
- `pnpm exec eslint --format json` over the four files: 4 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. This lint is narrowed: the four changed files are the whole population. `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware parsing, and nothing imports a test file, so no other file's verdict can move. `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- Each of these exited 0: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`.
- Not measured locally, left to CI: the other app-shell suites. No executable source changed, so the four files are the whole affected population.

**Reverse checks.** These ran once and were not committed. I used objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode on `packages/data-objectstack/src/metadata-client.ts`, the one place that tells a `/layers` 404 from a failure. Each restore was proven by a blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **R1, a 404 read as an error** (the layered 404 arm throws): 5 failed, 17 passed of 22.
  - Red: the edit page's draft-only load, plus objectui#11928's SAVE and DISCARD pins (their load fails first); the permission matrix's "+ New" save (no PUT); the list view's exists-nowhere load (`failure: absent`).
  - Green: every published control, every 5xx control, and the embedded editor's open (it sends no read).
- **R2, errors suppressed** (a 5xx resolves like the 404): 4 failed, 18 passed of 22, exactly the four 5xx controls.
  - The first R2 attempt was refused by the tool before anything ran, because its replacement contained the anchor. It was re-run with a two-line anchor.

## Acceptance notes

- **The console line stays.** The browser still logs its own network line for these four 404s. Triage on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22397 says neither repo controls that line.
- **A name the editor does not hold.** No draft and no layer: the edit page measured no error state for this today. It opens an empty form, and only a 5xx shows the load error. So the dispatch's "a 404 for an item the editor does not hold keeps its error state" has nothing to keep at that read, and this PR does not add one: that would be new behaviour and a new message. The 5xx is the error control pinned at every read.
- **Measured but outside this claim, which excludes it.** For a draft-only parent, the embedded item editor's save splices the item into an empty body and PUTs the parent in publish mode. Over the real `MetadataClient`, the request is a PUT to the object with no `mode=draft`, and its body holds only `fields.amount`. The editor then shows "Saved.". I did not measure the real server's answer. This is reported to the seat and not pinned, so nothing here holds that body in place.
- **Which PermissionMatrixEditor read.** The claim points at `readLayered` in the load. The read this remainder names (objectui#9420, other packages' rows) is the save's re-read. I measured both; the load's read is objectui#11928's and is unchanged.
